title: Multilayer membrane and hybrid fibrous-shell foundation
purpose: Verify the reusable kinematic, constitutive, neighboring-element, consistent-variation, MPI-assembly, multilayer-lowering, and result-identity foundation required before a global fibrous-shell element or forming procedure can be promoted.
physics: finite-kinematics woven-reinforcement membrane and local fibre-specific shell response

execution.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_composite_materials.py tests/test_mesh_neighborhood.py tests/test_fibrous_shell_reconstruction.py tests/test_fiber_bending_operator.py tests/test_cell_average_gradient.py tests/test_convected_cell_fiber.py tests/test_additive_tangent_matrix.py tests/test_hybrid_nonlinear.py
execution.evidence: Analytical local channels, a loaded finite-kinematics membrane solve, neighbor reconstruction, exact bending variations, FEM/cell transfers, additive PETSc algebra, an internal constrained hybrid Newton solve, and unified result identity run in serial; partition completeness, global virtual work, transfer adjoint, and serial/distributed hybrid observables run under two MPI ranks.
execution.serial: python -m pytest -q tests/test_composite_materials.py tests/test_mesh_neighborhood.py tests/test_fibrous_shell_reconstruction.py tests/test_fiber_bending_operator.py tests/test_cell_average_gradient.py tests/test_convected_cell_fiber.py tests/test_additive_tangent_matrix.py tests/test_hybrid_nonlinear.py

observables: Objective director-shell and fibre-curve measures under superposed rigid rotation.
Independent membrane, transverse-shear, in-plane-bending, and normal-bending energies, resultants, and tangent blocks.
Nine-component UFL stored energy and its automatically differentiated generalized resultants.
Operator-side symbolic membrane, director-shear, and fibre-curvature measures before compatibility constraints are introduced.
Minimal no-slip compatibility residual and its derived fibre unit/tangency diagnostics.
Ghost-complete neighboring-cell geometry, affine-exact gradients, objective reconstructed fibre curvature, and physical owned-cell measures.
Independent-direction bending energy, exact residual, consistent matrix-free tangent, and globally assembled DG0 virtual work.
Continuous scalar/vector FEM fields transferred to DG0 cell-average gradients and their exact transpose back to source dofs.
Displacement-derived current surface tangents, fibre stretch and unit direction plus their exact directional derivative and source-space adjoint.
Complete displacement-derived bending first variation through the direction and direct surface-tangent paths.
Matrix-free displacement-level consistent tangent from exact bending-response and kinematic-adjoint linearizations.
One public displacement-fibre-bending composition exposing energy, residual, tangent action, and ownership metadata.
An internal assembled-local plus matrix-free PETSc tangent with a separate assembled preconditioner and single constraint boundary.
A constrained hybrid Newton displacement/bending solve with serial and two-rank observables.
Stable computational-layer and physical-layer identities for varying-orientation stacks.
Per-layer DG result fields, aggregate stored energy, and the exact layer-to-field manifest from a completed model.step result.
acceptance: The three-dimensional surface deformation lift maps both reference tangents and the reference normal and transforms objectively.
Pure local shell channels remain independent, carry symmetric positive-semidefinite tangents, and sum to total stored energy.
UFL differentiation of the symbolic generalized stored energy recovers the nine explicit conjugate resultants component by component.
The symbolic mixed-field kinematic hand-off reproduces the local reference implementation and is invariant under superposed rigid rotation.
Exactly convected fibres and a unit director make all seven independent compatibility equations vanish; incompatible fields produce nonzero residuals and diagnostics.
A smooth rotating fibre field converges near second order, remains objective under a three-dimensional rigid rotation, and never mistakes an MPI partition interface for a physical boundary.

Bending energy derivatives match residual work, residual derivatives match the consistent tangent, the Hessian action is symmetric, and assembled two-rank residual work closes the global energy derivative.
Affine continuous scalar and three-component fields transfer exactly to cell-average gradients and satisfy the global two-rank forward/adjoint work identity.

A superposed rigid rotation convects the reference tangents and fibre exactly; displacement-derived tangent/stretch/direction increments match finite differences and close their global two-rank adjoint work identity.
The composed displacement-space bending residual matches finite-difference energy changes in serial and across a two-rank partition, including both direction and surface-tangent contributions.
The composed displacement-space tangent matches bending-residual differences in serial and across a two-rank partition.
The composed displacement energy is objective, its residual and tangent are rotation-covariant, and its Hessian action is symmetric.
The hybrid Newton solve converges with a nonzero local load and nonlocal bending response while preserving constrained dofs exactly.
Its displacement integral, bending energy, maximum response, and iteration count agree between serial and two-rank execution.
A conservative MPI neighbor energy rejects a stencil wider than the available shared-facet halo.
A membrane stack adds only compatible energy scalars and never combines generalized resultants expressed in unlike fibre frames.
Same-orientation grouping scales energy, conjugate resultants, and tangent by the number of explicitly listed physical layer IDs and rejects duplicate IDs.
A loaded multilayer membrane converges through the standard Step and writes collision-free per-layer strain, resultant, direction, and energy fields.
The in-plane membrane provider refuses every nonzero bending block rather than silently discarding shell mechanics.
limitations: This benchmark does not contain a complete displacement-coupled shell element, boundary moment, or transverse-slip solve.
It does not validate tool contact, friction, inter-ply slip, wrinkling, explicit quasi-static controls, or a physical drape experiment.

Standard increment, progress, checkpoint, SimulationResult, MPI result-field identity, boundary moments, complete shell assembly, and public shell/forming benchmarks remain promotion gates for the future global provider.
